tasks.title: Delete dead review.maxIterations config (old key keeps validating)
tasks.description:
Delete the dead `review.maxIterations` config option.

CONTEXT: `review.maxIterations` is loaded (src/config.ts ~56) and prompted for by init (src/commands/init.ts: ConfigDefaults.reviewMaxIterations ~140, the 'Auto-review max iterations' prompt ~195, the written config ~209), but nothing reads it. Worse, isValidConfig (src/types.ts) REJECTS a `review` block that lacks it. There are many references across test/types.test.ts, test/config.test.ts, test/commands/init.test.ts, test/commands/run.test.ts and test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts (grep for maxIterations; do not confuse it with runRun's unrelated `maxIterations` loop option in src/commands/run.ts, which stays).

CHANGES:
1. src/types.ts: CairnConfig.review becomes `{ postTask: boolean }`. isValidConfig stops requiring maxIterations but STILL ACCEPTS a review block that contains it (as a number) — existing configs must keep loading and validating cleanly.
2. src/config.ts loadConfig: stop emitting maxIterations; ignore the key if present.
3. src/commands/init.ts: remove reviewMaxIterations from ConfigDefaults / getConfigDefaults, remove the 'Auto-review max iterations' prompt from promptForConfig, and stop writing the key. IMPORTANT: init tests feed prompt answers POSITIONALLY; removing this prompt shifts every later answer — update the mock answer sequences carefully and make sure each assertion still checks the field it intends to.
4. Update all review.maxIterations test references. Add tests: a config with `review: { maxIterations: 3, postTask: true }` still validates and loads; a config with `review: { postTask: true }` validates.

DO NOT EDIT cairn.json AT ALL. This repository's cairn.json holds the user's uncommitted, redirected healthCheck (the binary is pinned for this self-modifying round). Removing `review.maxIterations` from this repo's cairn.json is a manual post-round step for the user; the old key must keep validating in the meantime. Do NOT modify healthCheck and do NOT run ./install.sh.

TDD: write the failing test first, run it and watch it fail, then implement until it passes — all within this task.

TEMP DIRS ONLY: never run `cairn init` or the init/claude-settings functions against this repository's root; exercise them only in temp directories created by the tests (fs.mkdtempSync).

COMMIT: stage only the files you changed (never `git add -A` or `git add .`) — never stage cairn.json.
tasks.notes:
# Task #107: Delete dead review.maxIterations config (old key keeps validating)

## TDD
- `test/types.test.ts`: rewrote the `isValidConfig` review-block tests — added
  `accepts config with review.postTask only` (new, red against old code since
  `maxIterations` was required) and `accepts config with legacy
  review.maxIterations alongside postTask (dead key, still validates)`
  (backward-compat), replaced `rejects review without maxIterations` with
  `rejects review without postTask`, replaced `rejects review.maxIterations
  that is not a number` with `rejects review.postTask that is not a boolean`.
  Ran first — `accepts config with review.postTask only` failed (`isValidConfig`
  still required `maxIterations`). Implemented the `src/types.ts` change, all
  31 tests in the file pass.
- `test/config.test.ts`: replaced the four `defaults/loads review.maxIterations`
  tests with `does not emit review.maxIterations when not specified` /
  `ignores legacy review.maxIterations from cairn.json instead of emitting it`
  / two `loads cleanly when review...is missing` tests, all asserting
  `config.review?.maxIterations` is `undefined`. Ran first — 4 failures (old
  `loadConfig` still emitted a numeric default). Implemented the `src/config.ts`
  change (dropped the `maxIterations` key from the returned `review` object,
  reviewRaw.maxIterations is read from disk but never copied into the result),
  all 51 tests pass. The pre-existing `isValidConfig review.postTask` /
  `loadConfig review.postTask` describe blocks (lines ~508-585) already used
  `review: { maxIterations: N, postTask: … }` fixtures and only asserted on
  `postTask` — left untouched, they continue to prove the legacy key doesn't
  break anything.
- `test/commands/init.test.ts`: removed `reviewMaxIterations` from
  `ConfigDefaults`/`baseDefaults`, replaced the `getConfigDefaults`
  reviewMaxIterations tests with ones asserting the field is absent even when
  legacy `review.maxIterations` is on disk, replaced the three
  `promptForConfig` maxIterations tests with one asserting no "max iterations"
  question is ever asked and `config.review` never contains the key, and
  shifted every positional mock-answer array in the later `promptForConfig`
  and `runInit` tests back by one slot (documented the new prompt order in
  each updated comment). Verified red/green by stashing just the `src/commands/init.ts`
  diff and re-running the suite: 8 failures against unmodified init.ts
  (wrong hook/settings/migration outcomes from the answer-array shift), 0
  failures after popping the stash back. Implemented: removed
  `reviewMaxIterations` from `ConfigDefaults`, from `getConfigDefaults`, and
  removed the "Auto-review max iterations" prompt + `Number.isNaN(...)`
  parsing from `promptForConfig` (it now only asks `reviewPostTask`). All 173
  tests in the file pass.
- `test/commands/run.test.ts`: sed-replaced the 9 identical
  `review: { postTask: true, maxIterations: 5 }` config fixtures with
  `review: { postTask: true } }`. Left all `maxIterations: N` occurrences that
  are `runRun`'s unrelated loop-count option (`makeRunOpts({ maxIterations })`)
  untouched, per the task's explicit warning not to confuse the two.
- `test/post-task-reviewer.test.ts`: dropped `maxIterations: 30` from the two
  `review: { ... }` fixtures in `makeConfig`/its override call.
- Full `bun test`: 1153 pass, 0 fail (34 files). Also ran `bunx tsc --noEmit -p
  tsconfig.json` to confirm no new type errors were introduced by the
  `CairnConfig.review` shape change — the only errors present are pre-existing
  and unrelated (bun-types `ffi.d.ts`/`wasm.d.ts` lib duplicate-identifier
  noise, and a pre-existing `Task.description` optionality mismatch in
  `post-task-reviewer.ts`/`settle.ts`).

## What was built
- `src/types.ts`: `CairnConfig.review` is now `{ postTask: boolean }` (dropped
  `maxIterations: number`). `isValidConfig` no longer requires or validates
  `review.maxIterations` — if a `review` block is present, only `postTask`
  (must be `boolean`) is checked. A `review` block that still carries a
  `maxIterations` key (old configs) is silently accepted; the key is ignored,
  not type-checked, since nothing reads it anymore.
- `src/config.ts`: `loadConfig`'s `review` output no longer includes
  `maxIterations`. `reviewRaw.maxIterations` is never read into the result —
  a `cairn.json` with a legacy `review.maxIterations` key loads without error,
  the key is just dropped on the floor.
- `src/commands/init.ts`: `ConfigDefaults` no longer has `reviewMaxIterations`.
  `getConfigDefaults` no longer computes it. `promptForConfig` no longer asks
  "Auto-review max iterations" and no longer writes `maxIterations` into the
  `review` object it returns — the written `cairn.json` from a fresh
  `cairn init` will only ever have `review: { postTask: boolean }`. The
  "Enable post-task review?" prompt is now the last prompt in
  `promptForConfig`, immediately after the narration sub-prompts (or after
  `narrationEnabled` when narration is off).

## Notes for the next task / iteration
- This repo's own `cairn.json` still has a `review.maxIterations` key. Per the
  task instructions I did NOT touch `cairn.json` at all — it also currently
  carries the round's pinned/redirected `healthCheck`
  (`/tmp/cairn-healthcheck`), which is explicitly user-managed for this
  self-modifying round (see CLAUDE.md's pin/unpin procedure). Removing the
  dead `review.maxIterations` key from this repo's `cairn.json` is a manual
  cleanup step for the user once the round ends and `healthCheck` is restored
  — it will keep validating and loading fine in the meantime (that was the
  whole point of this task).
- Did not touch `test/settle.test.ts` or `test/commands/round.test.ts` — both
  still reference `review: { ..., maxIterations: N }` in fixtures, but neither
  was in this task's assigned file list, and both only assert on `postTask`
  (or pass the config through untyped/loosely), so they keep passing unchanged
  as further proof the legacy key doesn't break anything downstream. If a
  future task wants full repo-wide cleanup of the dead key from test fixtures,
  those two files are the remaining spots (found via `grep -rn maxIterations
  test/`).
- No new tasks discovered/added this iteration — this was a narrowly-scoped
  cleanup task and I stayed within its boundaries (temp dirs only for
  init/claude-settings exercises, no `cairn init`/`./install.sh` run against
  the real repo root, `cairn.json` untouched).

tasks.title: Docs: CLAUDE.md and README.md for /cairn-run, cairn round, run state, hook enforcement
tasks.description:
Update the repo-root CLAUDE.md and README.md for Round 15. Documentation only — do not change code.

Read the current code first (src/settle.ts, src/run-state.ts, src/commands/round.ts, src/commands/hook.ts, src/claude-settings.ts, src/commands/init.ts, src/post-task-reviewer.ts, agents/cairn-task-agent.md, agents/post-task-reviewer.md, commands/cairn-run.md) and document what was actually built, not what was planned.

COVER:
1. Two ways to run a round: headless `cairn run` (the existing loop, a fresh `claude -p` per task) and interactive `/cairn-run` (a session reachable via Remote Control that drives `cairn round next` / `cairn round settle <id> [--reviewed] [--before-sha] [--test-timeout]`, launching `cairn-task-agent` subagents and the post-task-reviewer subagent one after another, never nested). Both share settleTask (src/settle.ts). Add `cairn round` (and `cairn hook`) to CLAUDE.md's execution-flow/command list and README's Commands section; explain why round commands are not under `cairn task` (a task agent calling settle would archive and skip its own review).
2. Run state: gitignored `.cairn_run_state.json` holding the iteration counter and per-task attempt records (beforeSha, reverts, stalls, incompletes, phase); counters survive restarts and compaction; `cairn task set-status` resets a task's record; thresholds are fixed (reverts 2, stalls 3, incompletes 3); settle order is validate → archive → review gate; verdicts and exit codes (0 for every verdict). Test output goes to `.cairn_task_<id>_tests.log`; prompts to `.cairn_task_<id>_prompt.md` and `.cairn_task_<id>_review_prompt.md`. Update CLAUDE.md's per-project data layout and the Conventions line saying where logic lives. Remove any surviving claim that guard counters are in-memory/per-run.
3. Enforcement under /cairn-run, added to CLAUDE.md's Agent workflow section WITHOUT weakening or contradicting the existing headless story (execution agents under `cairn run` are bound only by their system prompt; reviewer/planner by --allowedTools; headless mode is deny-by-default). Subagents follow the interactive session's permission mode, so --allowedTools scoping doesn't carry over. The PreToolUse hook `cairn hook pre-tool-use`, seeded into .claude/settings.local.json by init, checks agent_id/agent_type: it denies any subagent Edit/Write to tasks.json and scopes post-task-reviewer to reviews/ writes and read-only git Bash; it denies via exit 0 + JSON permissionDecision; it is FAIL-OPEN (internal errors exit non-zero, are logged to `.cairn_hook_errors.log`, and are surfaced by `cairn round next`); it is a no-op for main sessions, generate-tasks and headless `cairn run` agents (no agent_id). Record the hook probe facts so they are never re-derived: hook denies bind under bypassPermissions; exit 1 / 127 lets calls through silently; internal helpers send agent_id without agent_type.
4. Recommended permission mode for /cairn-run: bypassPermissions + hook; auto may be tried; default/acceptEdits stall unattended rounds.
5. The reviewer no longer runs tests (settle validates first; it gets a summary plus the log path), has an explicit tools list, and its headless grant no longer includes test-command rules — update CLAUDE.md's sentence saying the reviewer's Bash grants include 'one prefix rule per subcommand of the task's declared tests entries'.
6. CLAUDE.local.md replaces .cairn/instructions.md (deprecated for one release) — make CLAUDE.md consistent with README where task 106 left gaps.
7. Do NOT remove or alter the 'Pin/unpin procedure for self-modifying rounds' section.

PINNED BINARY (self-modifying round): do NOT modify cairn.json's healthCheck value and do NOT run ./install.sh. The user has pinned ~/.local/bin/cairn to a known-good build and redirected the health check to a throwaway outfile (/tmp/cairn-healthcheck).

COMMIT: stage only CLAUDE.md and README.md (never `git add -A` or `git add .`) — cairn.json has an uncommitted user change that must not be committed.
